items.title: v14 ng update
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/core@14 @angular/cli@14` which should bring you to version 14 of Angular.

items.title: update @angular/material
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/material@14`.

items.title: TypeScript 4.6
items.action: Angular now uses TypeScript 4.6, read more about [any potential breaking changes](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-4-6/).

items.title: v14 node
items.action: Make sure you are using [Node 14.15.0 or later](https://www.hostingadvice.com/how-to/update-node-js-latest-version/)

items.title: v14 strict forms
items.action: Form models now require a generic type parameter. For gradual migration you can opt-out using the untyped version of the form model classes.

items.title: v14 aotSummaries
items.action: Remove `aotSummaries` from `TestBed` since Angular no longer needs them in Ivy.

items.title: v14 MatVertical and Horizontal Stepper
items.action: If you are using `MatVerticalStepper` or `MatHorizontalStepper` make sure you switch to `MatStepper`.

items.title: v14 JSONP
items.action: Remove headers from JSONP requests. JSONP does not supports headers and if specified the HTTP module will now throw an error rather than ignoring them.

items.title: v14 resolvers
items.action: Resolvers now will take the first emitted value by an observable and after that proceed to navigation to better align with other guards rather than taking the last emitted value.

items.title: v14 deprecate protractor entry
items.action: The deprecated `angular/cdk/testing/protractor` entry point is now removed.

items.title: v14 chipInput
items.action: Make sure you specify `chipInput` of `MatChipInputEvent` because it is now required.

items.title: v14 mixinErrorState
items.action: You need to implement `stateChanges` class member in abstractions using `mixinErrorState` because the mixin no longer provides it.

items.title: v14 CdkStepper orientation
items.action: Use `CdkStepper.orientation` instead of `CdkStepper._orientation`.

items.title: v14 CdkStepper and MatStepper
items.action: If you are extending or using `CdkStepper` or `MatStepper` in the constructor you should no longer pass the `_document` parameter since it is now removed.

items.title: v14 mat-list-item-avatar
items.action: Rename the `mat-list-item-avatar` CSS class to `mat-list-item-with-avatar`.

items.title: v14 MatSelectionListChange.option
items.action: Use `MatSelectionListChange.options` rather than `MatSelectionListChange.option`.

items.title: v14 getHarnessLoaderForContent
items.action: Use `getChildLoader(MatListItemSection.CONTENT)` rather than `getHarnessLoaderForContent`.

items.title: v14 MatSelectionList
items.action: If you are using `MatSelectionList` make sure you pass `_focusMonitor` in its constructor because it is now required. Additionally, this class no longer has `tabIndex` property and a `tabIndex` constructor parameter.

items.title: v14 initialNavigation
items.action: Update `initialNavigation: 'enabled'` to `initialNavigation: 'enabledBlocking'`.

items.title: v14 Route.pathMatch
items.action: If you are defining routes with `pathMatch`, you may have to cast it to `Route` or `Routes` explicitly. `Route.pathMatch` is no longer compatible with `string` type.

items.title: v14 stricter LoadChildrenCallback
items.action: The promise returned by `LoadChildrenCallback` now has a stricter type parameter `Type<any>|NgModuleFactory<any>` rather than `any`.

items.title: v14 router scheduling
items.action: The router does no longer schedule redirect navigation within a `setTimeout`. Make sure your tests do not rely on this behavior.

items.title: v14 LocationStrategy
items.action: Implementing the `LocationStrategy` interface now requires definition of `getState()`.

items.title: v14 http queries
items.action: Sending `+` as part of a query no longer requires workarounds since `+` no longer sends a space.

items.title: v14 AnimationDriver.getParentElement
items.action: Implementing `AnimationDriver` now requires the `getParentElement` method.

items.title: v14 invalid config
items.action: Invalid route configurations of lazy-loaded modules will now throw an error rather than being ignored.

items.title: v14 router resolver
items.action: Remove the `resolver` from `RouterOutletContract.activateWith` function and the `resolver` from `OutletContext` class since factory resolvers are no longer needed.

items.title: v14 initialUrl
items.action: `Router.initialUrl` accepts only `UrlTree` to prevent a misuse of the API by assigning a `string` value.

items.title: v15 node support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of node.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v15 supports node.js versions: 14.20.x, 16.13.x and 18.10.x. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-01)

items.title: v15 ts support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of TypeScript before you upgrade your application. Angular v15 supports TypeScript version 4.8 or later.  [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-02)

items.title: v15 ng update
items.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@15 @angular/cli@15` to update your application to Angular v15.

items.title: V15 update @angular/material
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/material@15` to update the Material components.

items.title: v15 keyframe
items.action: In v15, the Angular compiler prefixes `@keyframes` in CSS with the component's scope. This means that any TypeScript code that relies on `keyframes` names no longer works in v15. Update any such instances to: define keyframes programmatically, use global stylesheets, or change the component's view encapsulation. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-03)

items.title: v15 no-ivy
items.action: In your application's `tsconfig.json` file, remove `enableIvy`. In v15, Ivy is the only rendering engine so `enableIvy` is not required.

items.title: v15 base-decorators
items.action: Make sure to use decorators in base classes with child classes that inherit constructors and use dependency injection. Such base classes should be decorated with either `@Injectable` or `@Directive` or the compiler returns an error. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-05)

items.title: v15 setDisabledState
items.action: In v15, `setDisabledState` is always called when a `ControlValueAccessor` is attached. To opt-out of this behavior, use `FormsModule.withConfig` or `ReactiveFormsModule.withConfig`. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-06)

items.title: v15 canParse
items.action: Applications that use `canParse` should use `analyze` from `@angular/localize/tools` instead. In v15, the `canParse` method was removed from all translation parsers in `@angular/localize/tools`.  [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-07)

items.title: v15 ActivatedRoutSnapshot
items.action: Make sure that all `ActivatedRouteSnapshot` objects have a `title` property. In v15, the `title` property is a required property of `ActivatedRouteSnapshot`. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-08)

items.title: v15 RouterOutlet
items.action: If your tests with `RouterOutlet` break, make sure they don't depend on the instantiation order of the corresponding component relative to change detection. In v15, `RouterOutlet` instantiates the component after change detection. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-09)

items.title: v15 relativeLinkResolution
items.action: In v15, `relativeLinkResolution` is not configurable in the Router. It was used to opt out of an earlier bug fix that is now standard.  [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-bc-10)

items.title: v15 DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS
items.action: Change instances of the `DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE` token to use `DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS` to configure time zones.  In v15, the `DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE` token is deprecated. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-01)

items.title: v15 iframe
items.action: Existing `<iframe>` instances might have security-sensitive attributes applied to them as an attribute or property binding. These security-sensitive attributes can occur in a template or in a directive's host bindings. Such occurrences require an update to ensure compliance with the new and stricter rules about `<iframe>` bindings. For more information, see [the error page](https://v15.angular.io/errors/NG0910).

items.title: v15 Injector.get
items.action: Update instances of `Injector.get()` that use an `InjectFlags` parameter to use an `InjectOptions` parameter. The `InjectFlags` parameter of `Injector.get()` is deprecated in v15. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-02)

items.title: v15 TestBed.inject
items.action: Update instances of `TestBed.inject()` that use an `InjectFlags` parameter to use an `InjectOptions` parameter. The `InjectFlags` parameter of `TestBed.inject()` is deprecated in v15. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-01)

items.title: v15 ngModule in providedIn
items.action: Using `providedIn: ngModule` for an `@Injectable` and `InjectionToken` is deprecated in v15. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-04)

items.title: v15 providedIn any
items.action: Using `providedIn: 'any'` for an `@Injectable` or `InjectionToken` is deprecated in v15. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-05)

items.title: v15 RouterLinkWithHref
items.action: Update instances of the `RouterLinkWithHref`directive to use the `RouterLink` directive. The `RouterLinkWithHref` directive is deprecated in v15. [Read further](https://v15.angular.io/guide/update-to-version-15#v15-dp-06)

items.title: v15 mat refactor
items.action: In Angular Material v15, many of the components have been refactored to be based on the official Material Design Components for Web (MDC). This change affected the DOM and CSS classes of many components. [Read further](https://rc.material.angular.dev/guide/mdc-migration)

items.title: v15 visual review
items.action: After you update your application to v15, visually review your application and its interactions to ensure everything is working as it should.

items.title: v16 node support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of node.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports node.js versions: v16 and v18.

items.title: v16 ts support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of TypeScript before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports TypeScript version 4.9.3 or later.

items.title: v16 ng update
items.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@16 @angular/cli@16` to update your application to Angular v16.

items.title: update @angular/material
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/material@16`.

items.title: v16 zone.js support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of Zone.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v16 supports Zone.js version 0.13.x or later.

items.title: v16 RouterEvent
items.action: The Event union no longer contains `RouterEvent`, which means that if you're using the Event type you may have to change the type definition from `(e: Event)` to `(e: Event|RouterEvent)`

items.title: v16 routerEvent prop type
items.action: In addition to `NavigationEnd` the `routerEvent` property now also accepts type `NavigationSkipped`

items.title: v16 RendererType2
items.action: Pass only flat arrays to `RendererType2.styles` because it no longer accepts nested arrays

items.title: v16 BrowserPlatformLocation
items.action: You may have to update tests that use `BrowserPlatformLocation` because `MockPlatformLocation` is now provided by default in tests. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#common-9).

items.title: v16 ngcc
items.action: Due to the removal of the Angular Compatibility Compiler (ngcc) in v16, projects on v16 and later no longer support View Engine libraries.

items.title: v16 createUrlTree
items.action: After bug fixes in `Router.createUrlTree` you may have to readjust tests which mock `ActivatedRoute`. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1600-2023-05-03)

items.title: v16 ApplicationConfig imports
items.action: Change imports of `ApplicationConfig` to be from `@angular/core`.

items.title: v16 renderModule
items.action: Revise your code to use `renderModule` instead of `renderModuleFactory` because it has been deleted.

items.title: v16 XhrFactory
items.action: Revise your code to use `XhrFactory` from `@angular/common` instead of `XhrFactory` export from `@angular/common/http`.

items.title: v16 withServerTransition
items.action: If you're running multiple Angular apps on the same page and you're using `BrowserModule.withServerTransition({ appId: 'serverApp' })` make sure you set the `APP_ID` instead since `withServerTransition` is now deprecated. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#platform-browser-4)

items.title: v16 EnvironmentInjector
items.action: Change `EnvironmentInjector.runInContext` to `runInInjectionContext` and pass the environment injector as the first parameter.

items.title: v16 ViewContainerRef.createComponent
items.action: Update your code to use `ViewContainerRef.createComponent` without the factory resolver. `ComponentFactoryResolver` has been removed from Router APIs.

items.title: v16 APP_ID
items.action: If you bootstrap multiple apps on the same page, make sure you set unique `APP_IDs`.

items.title: v16 server renderApplication
items.action: Update your code to revise `renderApplication` method as it no longer accepts a root component as first argument, but instead a callback that should bootstrap your app. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#platform-server-3)

items.title: v16 PlatformConfig.baseUrl
items.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `PlatformConfig.baseUrl` and `PlatformConfig.useAbsoluteUrl` platform-server config options as it has been deprecated.

items.title: v16 moduleid
items.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `@Directive`/`@Component` `moduleId` property as it does not have any effect and will be removed in v17.

items.title: v16 transfer state imports
items.action: Update imports from `import {makeStateKey, StateKey, TransferState} from '@angular/platform-browser'` to `import {makeStateKey, StateKey, TransferState} from '@angular/core'`

items.title: v16 ComponentRef
items.action: If you rely on `ComponentRef.setInput` to set the component input even if it's the same based on `Object.is` equality check, make sure you copy its value.

items.title: v16 ANALYZE_FOR_ENTRY_COMPONENTS
items.action: Update your code to remove any reference to `ANALYZE_FOR_ENTRY_COMPONENTS` injection token as it has been deleted.

items.title: v16 entry components
items.action: `entryComponents` is no longer available and any reference to it can be removed from the `@NgModule` and `@Component` public APIs.

items.title: v16 ngTemplateOutletContext
items.action: ngTemplateOutletContext has stricter type checking which requires you to declare all the properties in the corresponding object. [Read further](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#common-1).

items.title: v16 APF
items.action: Angular packages no longer include FESM2015 and the distributed ECMScript has been updated from 2020 to 2022.

items.title: v16 EventManager
items.action: The deprecated `EventManager` method `addGlobalEventListener` has been removed as it is not used by Ivy.

items.title: v16 BrowserTransferStateModule
items.action: `BrowserTransferStateModule` is no longer available and any reference to it can be removed from your applications.

items.title: v16 ReflectiveInjector
items.action: Update your code to use `Injector.create` rather than `ReflectiveInjector` since `ReflectiveInjector` is removed.

items.title: v16 QueryList
items.action: `QueryList.filter` now supports type guard functions. Since the type will be narrowed, you may have to update your application code that relies on the old behavior.

items.title: v17 node support

items.title: v17 ts support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of TypeScript before you upgrade your application. Angular v17 supports TypeScript version 5.2 or later.

items.title: v17 zone.js support
items.action: Make sure that you are using a supported version of Zone.js before you upgrade your application. Angular v17 supports Zone.js version 0.14.x or later.

items.title: v17 ng update
items.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@17 @angular/cli@17` to update your application to Angular v17.

items.title: update @angular/material
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/material@17`.

items.title: v17 style removal
items.action: Angular now automatically removes styles of destroyed components, which may impact your existing apps in cases you rely on leaked styles. To change this update the value of the `REMOVE_STYLES_ON_COMPONENT_DESTROY` provider to `false`.

items.title: v17 router removals
items.action: Make sure you configure `setupTestingRouter`, `canceledNavigationResolution`, `paramsInheritanceStrategy`, `titleStrategy`, `urlUpdateStrategy`, `urlHandlingStrategy`, and `malformedUriErrorHandler` in `provideRouter` or `RouterModule.forRoot` since these properties are now not part of the `Router`'s public API

items.title: v17 ngDoCheck dynamic components
items.action: For dynamically instantiated components we now execute `ngDoCheck` during change detection if the component is marked as dirty. You may need to update your tests or logic within `ngDoCheck` for dynamically instantiated components.

items.title: v17 malformedUriErrorHandler
items.action: Handle URL parsing errors in the `UrlSerializer.parse` instead of `malformedUriErrorHandler` because it's now part of the public API surface.

items.title: v17 zone deep imports
items.action: Change Zone.js deep imports like `zone.js/bundles/zone-testing.js` and `zone.js/dist/zone` to `zone.js` and `zone.js/testing`.

items.title: v17 absolute redirects
items.action: You may need to adjust your router configuration to prevent infinite redirects after absolute redirects. In v17 we no longer prevent additional redirects after absolute redirects.

items.title: v17 AnimationDriver
items.action: Change references to `AnimationDriver.NOOP` to use `NoopAnimationDriver` because `AnimationDriver.NOOP` is now deprecated.

items.title: v17 switch strictness
items.action: You may need to adjust the equality check for `NgSwitch` because now it defaults to stricter check with `===` instead of `==`. Angular will log a warning message for the usages where you'd need to provide an adjustment.

items.title: v17 mutate in signals
items.action: Use `update` instead of `mutate` in Angular Signals. For example `items.mutate(itemsArray => itemsArray.push(newItem));` will now be `items.update(itemsArray => [itemsArray, …newItem]);`

items.title: v17 withNoDomReuse
items.action: To disable hydration use `ngSkipHydration` or remove the `provideClientHydration` call from the provider list since `withNoDomReuse` is no longer part of the public API.

items.title: v17 paramsInheritanceStrategy

items.title: 18.0.0 Upgrade TypeScript

items.title: 18.0.0: async has been removed, use `waitForAsync` instead
items.action: Replace `async` from `@angular/core` with `waitForAsync`.

items.title: 18.0.0: Deprecated matchesElement method removed from AnimationDriver
items.action: Remove calls to `matchesElement` because it's now not part of `AnimationDriver`.

items.title: 18.0.0. Use `@angular/core` StateKey and TransferState
items.action: Import `StateKey` and `TransferState` from `@angular/core` instead of `@angular/platform-browser`.

items.title: 18.0.0. Opt-in of caching for HTTP requests with auth headers
items.action: Use `includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders: true` in `withHttpTransferCache` to opt-in of caching for HTTP requests that require authorization.

items.title: 18.0.0.REMOVE_OBSOLETE_IS_WORKER
items.action: Update the application to remove `isPlatformWorkerUi` and `isPlatformWorkerApp` since they were part of platform WebWorker which is now not part of Angular.

items.title: 18.0.0.FORCE_ZONE_CHANGE_DETECTION
items.action: Tests may run additional rounds of change detection to fully reflect test state in the DOM. As a last resort, revert to the old behavior by adding `provideZoneChangeDetection({ignoreChangesOutsideZone: true})` to the TestBed providers.

items.title: 18.0.0: Remove two-way binding expressions in writable bindings
items.action: Remove expressions that write to properties in templates that use `[(ngModel)]`

items.title: 18.0.0: Use zones to track pending requests
items.action: Remove calls to `Testability` methods `increasePendingRequestCount`, `decreasePendingRequestCount`, and `getPendingRequestCount`. This information is tracked by ZoneJS.

items.title: 18.0.0: Move shared providers to the routed component
items.action: Move any environment providers that should be available to routed components from the component that defines the `RouterOutlet` to the providers of `bootstrapApplication` or the `Route` config.

items.title: 18.0.0 Use RedirectCommand or new NavigationBehaviorOptions
items.action: When a guard returns a `UrlTree` as a redirect, the redirecting navigation will now use `replaceUrl` if the initial navigation was also using the `replaceUrl` option. If you prefer the previous behavior, configure the redirect using the new `NavigationBehaviorOptions` by returning a `RedirectCommand` with the desired options instead of `UrlTree`.

items.title: 18.0.0: Remove deprecated resource cache providers
items.action: Remove dependencies of `RESOURCE_CACHE_PROVIDER` since it's no longer part of the Angular runtime.

items.title: 18.0.0: Update Node.js URL parsing in `ServerPlatformLocation`
items.action: In `@angular/platform-server` now `pathname` is always suffixed with `/` and the default ports for http: and https: respectively are 80 and 443.

items.title: 18.0.0. Use absolute URLs
items.action: Provide an absolute `url` instead of using `useAbsoluteUrl` and `baseUrl` from `PlatformConfig`.

items.title: 18.0.0. Switch from `platformDynamicServer` to `platformServer`.
items.action: Replace the usage of `platformDynamicServer` with `platformServer`. Also, add an `import @angular/compiler`.

items.title: 18.0.0. Remove `ServerTransferStateModule` from app imports
items.action: Remove all imports of `ServerTransferStateModule` from your application. It is no longer needed.

items.title: 18.0.0. Update `Route.redirectTo` to accept functions
items.action: `Route.redirectTo` can now include a function in addition to a string. Any code which reads `Route` objects directly and expects `redirectTo` to be a string may need to update to account for functions as well.

items.title: 18.0.0: Guards can return `RedirectCommand`
items.action: `Route` guards and resolvers can now return a `RedirectCommand` object in addition to a `UrlTree` and `boolean`. Any code which reads `Route` objects directly and expects only `boolean` or `UrlTree` may need to update to account for `RedirectCommand` as well.

items.title: 18.0.0: Mark `OnPush` views dirty
items.action: For any components using `OnPush` change detection, ensure they are properly marked dirty to enable host binding updates.

items.title: 18.0.0-Refresh-Newly-Created-Views
items.action: Be aware that newly created views or views marked for check and reattached during change detection are now guaranteed to be refreshed in that same change detection cycle.

items.title: 18.0.0: `ComponentFixture.whenStable` matches `ApplicationRef.isStable`
items.action: After aligning the semantics of `ComponentFixture.whenStable` and `ApplicationRef.isStable`, your tests may wait longer when using `whenStable`.

items.title: 18.0.0. `ComponentFixture.autoDetect` behavior more closely matches Application behavior
items.action: You may experience tests failures if you have tests that rely on change detection execution order when using `ComponentFixture.autoDetect` because it now executes change detection for fixtures within `ApplicationRef.tick`. items.title: 20.0.0_rename_afterRender_to_afterEveryRender
items.action: Rename the `afterRender` lifecycle hook to `afterEveryRender`

items.title: 20.0.0_replace_TestBed_flushEffects_with_tick
items.action: Replace uses of `TestBed.flushEffects()` with `TestBed.tick()`, the closest equivalent to synchronously flush effects.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_provideCheckNoChangesConfig
items.action: Rename `provideExperimentalCheckNoChangesForDebug` to `provideCheckNoChangesConfig`. Note its behavior now applies to all `checkNoChanges` runs. The `useNgZoneOnStable` option is no longer available.

items.title: 20.0.0_refactor_ng_reflect_attributes_usage
items.action: Refactor application and test code to avoid relying on `ng-reflect-*` attributes. If needed temporarily for migration, use `provideNgReflectAttributes()` from `@angular/core` in bootstrap providers to re-enable them in dev mode only.

items.title: 20.0.0_adjust_RedirectFn_return_type_handling
items.action: Adjust code that directly calls functions returning `RedirectFn`. These functions can now also return an `Observable` or `Promise`; ensure your logic correctly handles these asynchronous return types.

items.title: 20.0.0_rename_resource_request_to_param
items.action: Rename the `request` property passed in resources to `params`.

items.title: 20.0.0_rename_rxResource_loader_to_stream
items.action: Rename the `request` and `loader` properties passed in RxResource to `params` and `stream`.

items.title: 20.0.0_replace_ResourceStatus_by_corresponding_strings
items.action: `ResourceStatus` is no longer an enum. Use the corresponding constant string values instead.

items.title: 20.0.0_rename_provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection
items.action: Rename `provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection` to `provideZonelessChangeDetection`.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_template_expressions_using_in_property
items.action: If your templates use `{{ in }}` or `in` in expressions to refer to a component property named 'in', change it to `{{ this.in }}` or `this.in` as 'in' now refers to the JavaScript 'in' operator. If you're using `in` as a template reference, you'd have to rename the reference.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_router_method_array_parameters_to_readonly
items.action: The type for the commands arrays passed to Router methods (`createUrlTree`, `navigate`, `createUrlTreeFromSnapshot`) have been updated to use `readonly T[]` since the array is not mutated. Code which extracts these types (e.g. with `typeof`) may need to be adjusted if it expects mutable arrays.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_animation_tests_for_guaranteed_flushing
items.action: Review and update tests asserting on DOM elements involved in animations. Animations are now guaranteed to be flushed with change detection or `ApplicationRef.tick`, potentially altering previous test outcomes.

items.title: 20.0.0_handle_uncaught_listener_errors_in_tests
items.action: In tests, uncaught errors in event listeners are now rethrown by default. Previously, these were only logged to the console by default. Catch them if intentional for the test case, or use `rethrowApplicationErrors: false` in `configureTestingModule` as a last resort.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_route_guards_array_types
items.action: The `any` type is removed from the Route guard arrays (canActivate, canDeactivate, etc); ensure guards are functions, `ProviderToken<T>`, or (deprecated) strings. Refactor string guards to `ProviderToken<T>` or functions.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_nodejs_version
items.action: Ensure your Node.js version is at least 20.11.1 and not v18 or v22.0-v22.10 before upgrading to Angular v20. Check the [full list of supported Node.js versions](https://angular.dev/reference/versions).

items.title: 20.0.0_replace_TestBed_get_with_TestBed_inject
items.action: Replace all occurrences of the deprecated `TestBed.get()` method with `TestBed.inject()` in your Angular tests for dependency injection.

items.title: 20.0.0_remove_InjectFlags_usage
items.action: Remove `InjectFlags` enum and its usage from `inject`, `Injector.get`, `EnvironmentInjector.get`, and `TestBed.inject` calls. Use options like `{optional: true}` for `inject` or handle null for `*.get` methods.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_injector_get_calls_to_use_ProviderToken
items.action: Update `injector.get()` calls to use a specific `ProviderToken<T>` instead of relying on the removed `any` overload. If using string tokens (deprecated since v4), migrate them to `ProviderToken<T>`.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_typescript_version
items.action: Upgrade your project's TypeScript version to at least 5.8 before upgrading to Angular v20 to ensure compatibility.

items.title: 20.0.0_set_moduleResolution_to_bundler
items.action: Set `moduleResolution` to `'bundler'` in your `tsconfig.json`. Angular CLI's `ng update` migration applies this change automatically; if you upgrade manually or override the option in a base tsconfig, set it explicitly so imports of secondary entry-points such as `@angular/core/rxjs-interop` continue to resolve correctly.

items.title: 20.0.0_review_AsyncPipe_error_handling_in_tests
items.action: `Unhandled errors in subscriptions/promises of AsyncPipe` are now directly reported to `ErrorHandler`. This may alter test outcomes; ensure tests correctly handle these reported errors.

items.title: 20.0.0_refactor_PendingTasks_run_usage
items.action: If relying on the return value of `PendingTasks.run`, refactor to use `PendingTasks.add`. Handle promise results/rejections manually, especially for SSR to prevent node process shutdown on unhandled rejections.

items.title: 20.0.0_update_template_expressions_using_void_property
items.action: If your templates use `{{ void }}` or `void` in expressions to refer to a component property named 'void', change it to `{{ this.void }}` or `this.void` as 'void' now refers to the JavaScript `void` operator.

items.title: 20.0.0_review_date_pipe_formatter_Y_usage
items.action: Review `DatePipe` usages. Using the `Y` (week-numbering year) formatter without also including `w` (week number) is now detected as suspicious. Use `y` (year) if that was the intent, or include `w` alongside `Y`.

items.title: 20.0.0_handle_uncaught_listener_errors_in_tests
items.action: In templates parentheses are now always respected. This can lead to runtime breakages when nullish coalescing were nested in parathesis. eg `(foo?.bar).baz` will throw if `foo` is nullish as it would in native JavaScript.

items.title: 20.0.0_router_generate_error_redirectTo_and_canMatch_incompatible_together
items.action: Route configurations are now validated more rigorously. Routes that combine `redirectTo` and `canMatch` protections will generate an error, as these properties are incompatible together by default.

items.title: 21.0.0-remove-ignore-changes-outside-zone-option

items.title: 21.0.0-testbed-rethrows-errors-with-provideZoneChangeDetection

items.title: 21.0.0-router-navigation-timing-changed
items.action: Update tests that rely on router navigation timing. Navigations may now take additional microtasks to complete. Ensure navigations are fully completed before making assertions, for example by using `fakeAsync` with `flush` or waiting for promises/observables to resolve.

items.title: 21.0.0-test-bed-provides-fake-platform-location
items.action: Tests using `TestBed` might be affected by the new fake `PlatformLocation`. If your tests fail, provide the old `MockPlatformLocation` from `@angular/common/testing` via `{provide: PlatformLocation, useClass: MockPlatformLocation}` in your `TestBed` configuration.

items.title: 21.0.0-remove-upgrade-adapter
items.action: The `UpgradeAdapter` has been removed. Update your hybrid Angular/AngularJS application to use the static APIs from the `@angular/upgrade/static` package instead.

items.title: 21.0.0-form-array-directive-conflict
items.action: The new standalone `formArray` directive might conflict with existing custom directives or inputs. Rename any custom directives named `FormArray` or inputs named `formArray` on elements that also use reactive forms to resolve the conflict.

items.title: 21.0.0-ngmodulefactory-removed
items.action: The deprecated `NgModuleFactory` has been removed. Update any code that uses `NgModuleFactory` to use `NgModule` directly, which is common in dynamic component loading scenarios.

items.title: 21.0.0-emit-declaration-only-not-supported
items.action: The `emitDeclarationOnly` TypeScript compiler option is not supported. Please disable it in your `tsconfig.json` file to allow the Angular compiler to function correctly.

items.title: 21.0.0-lastsuccessfulnavigation-is-a-signal
items.action: The `lastSuccessfulNavigation` property on the Router has been converted to a signal. To get its value, you now need to invoke it as a function: `router.lastSuccessfulNavigation()`.

items.title: 21.0.0-configure-commonengine-allowed-hosts
items.action: Starting `@angular/ssr` 21.1.5, if your application uses SSR with `CommonEngine`, set the `allowedHosts` option in your `server.ts` (for example, `new CommonEngine({allowedHosts: ['localhost', '*.yourdomain.com']})`). Without it, SSR silently falls back to client-side rendering. This requirement comes from security advisory [GHSA-x288-3778-4hhx](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/security/advisories/GHSA-x288-3778-4hhx) (also backported to 20.3.17 and 19.2.21).

items.title: 22.0.0_ng_update
items.action: In the application's project directory, run `ng update @angular/core@22 @angular/cli@22` to update your application to Angular v22.

items.title: update @angular/material
items.action: Run `ng update @angular/material@22`.

items.title: 22.0.0-update-nodejs-version
items.action: Angular v22 requires Node.js v22.22.3 or v24.15.0 and later. Update your Node.js version to meet this minimum requirement. You can check your current version with `node --version`.

items.title: 22.0.0-update-typescript-version
items.action: Update your project to use TypeScript 6.0 or later. Versions older than 6.0 are no longer supported. Use `ng update` which will handle this automatically.

items.title: 22.0.0-data-attributes-input-output-binding
items.action: Data-prefixed attributes (e.g., `data-*`) no longer bind to inputs or outputs. If you were relying on this behavior, use explicit property bindings instead (e.g., `[attr.data-value]="value"` or `[dataValue]="value"` for a component input).

items.title: 22.0.0-duplicate-input-output-bindings
items.action: The compiler now throws an error when inputs, outputs, or model are binding to the same property/output. Review your component decorators and ensure no duplicate bindings exist.

items.title: 22.0.0-safe-navigation-nullability-narrowing
items.action: Safe navigation (`?.`) and nullish coalescing (`??`) now correctly narrow down nullable types in templates. This may trigger `nullishCoalescingNotNullable` and `optionalChainNotNullable` diagnostics on existing projects. Either fix the diagnostics by updating your templates, or temporarily disable them in your `tsconfig.json` under `angularCompilerOptions`.

items.title: 22.0.0-safe-navigation-returns-undefined
items.action: Angular expressions with optional chaining (`?.`) now return `undefined` instead of `null`. You can use the `$safeNavigationMigration()` magic function to revert to the previous behavior.

items.title: 22.0.0-resource-stream-synchronous-resolution
items.action: The `stream` property on `Resource`, including `rxResource`, now resolves synchronously when the stream or observable emits synchronously. Tests that assumed asynchronous resolution may need to wait for the value immediately instead.

items.title: 22.0.0-remove-in-expressions
items.action: `in` variables in template expressions now throw an error as it does in native JavaScript. If you have variables named `in` in your component or template, update your template expressions to use `this.in` or rename your variable.

items.title: 22.0.0-animation-callback-event-signature-change
items.action: The `AnimationCallbackEvent.animationComplete` signature has changed. Update any code that depends on the old signature of this event. Review your animation event handlers and tests.

items.title: 22.0.0-http-xhr-backend-explicit-opt-in
items.action: If your application uses upload progress reporting through `HttpXhrBackend`, explicitly opt-in by using `provideHttpClient(withXhr())`. The default HTTP client no longer includes XHR support by default.

items.title: 22.0.0-deprecate-report-progress-option
items.action: The `reportProgress` option in HTTP requests is deprecated. Use `reportUploadProgress` or `reportDownloadProgress` instead for more explicit control over progress reporting.

items.title: 22.0.0-deprecate-server-xhr
items.action: XHR support in `@angular/platform-server` is deprecated and is intended to be removed in Angular 23. The underlying `xhr2` library does not safely handle redirects (e.g. it can forward `Authorization` headers on cross-origin redirects and is susceptible to DoS via redirect loops). For server-side rendering, use the default `fetch` backend instead of `withXhr()`.

items.title: 22.0.0-provide-routes-removed
items.action: `provideRoutes()` has been removed. Use `provideRouter()` instead, or configure routes as a multi token using `ROUTES` if necessary. Update your application bootstrap configuration.

items.title: 22.0.0-upgrade-angular-js-global-migration
items.action: If using AngularJS interoperability, replace deprecated `getAngularLib()` and `setAngularLib()` with `getAngularJSGlobal()` and `setAngularJSGlobal()` respectively.

items.title: 22.0.0-remove-component-factory-resolver
items.action: `ComponentFactoryResolver` and `ComponentFactory` are no longer available. Pass the component class directly to APIs like `ViewContainerRef.createComponent()` or use the standalone `createComponent()` function instead.

items.title: 22.0.0-remove-create-ng-module-ref
items.action: `createNgModuleRef` has been removed. Use `createNgModule()` instead for dynamic module creation scenarios.

items.title: 22.0.0-compile-time-duplicate-selectors
items.action: Elements with multiple matching selectors now throw a compile-time error. Ensure your components use unique selectors and review any directives that might have conflicting selectors.

items.title: 22.0.0-component-onpush-default
items.action: Components with no `changeDetection` property defined are now `OnPush` by default. To maintain `Eager` (the previous default) change detection, explicitly set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager` in your component decorator.

items.title: 22.0.0-remove-check-no-changes
items.action: `ChangeDetectorRef.checkNoChanges()` has been removed. In tests, use `fixture.detectChanges()` instead or verify your component state through other means.

items.title: 22.0.0-leave-animations-scope-change
items.action: Leave animations are no longer limited to the element being removed. They now support nested animations scoped to component boundaries. Review your animation configurations if you relied on the previous scoping behavior.

items.title: 22.0.0-params-inheritance-strategy-default
items.action: `paramsInheritanceStrategy` now defaults to `"always"` instead of `"emptyOnly"`. This means route parameters are inherited from all parent routes. To restore the previous behavior, explicitly set `paramsInheritanceStrategy: "emptyOnly"` in your router configuration.

items.title: 22.0.0-can-match-current-snapshot-required
items.action: The `currentSnapshot` parameter in `CanMatchFn` and the `canMatch` method of the `CanMatch` interface is now required. Update any class implementations of `CanMatch` to include this required third argument.

items.title: 22.0.0-hammer-js-removed
items.action: Hammer.js integration has been removed from Angular platform-browser. If you need touch gesture support, implement your own gesture detection or use an alternative library.

items.title: 22.0.0-app-ref-bootstrap-typing
items.action: The second argument of `appRef.bootstrap()` no longer accepts `any` type. Ensure the element you pass is not nullable and matches the expected type.

items.title: 22.0.0-platform-browser-styles-removal
items.action: Unused styles are now automatically removed when their associated `host` is dropped. Be aware that other DOM on the page may be affected if those styles are used by elements outside of Angular or if not using `ViewEncapsulation.Emulated`.

items.title: 22.0.0-title-strategy-return-type
items.action: The return type for `TitleStrategy.getResolvedTitleForRoute` has changed from `any` to a stricter type (e.g., `string | undefined`). Update your custom `TitleStrategy` implementations to match the new signature.

items.title: 22.0.0-incremental-hydration-default
items.action: Incremental hydration is now the default behavior for applications using Server-Side Rendering (SSR). Review your application if you relied on the previous non-incremental hydration behavior. You can use `withNoIncrementalHydration()` to restore the previous behavior if needed.

items.title: 22.0.0-full-template-type-check-removed
items.action: The `fullTemplateTypeCheck` compiler option has been removed. Use `strictTemplates` instead to enable strict template type checking in your `tsconfig.json`.

items.title: 22.0.0-strict-templates-default
items.action: The `strictTemplates` compiler option now defaults to `true`. If your project was not using strict template type checking, you may see new compilation errors. Resolve these errors or explicitly set `strictTemplates: false` in your `tsconfig.json` to opt out.

items.title: 22.0.0-webpack-builders-deprecated
items.action: Webpack builders (`@angular-devkit/build-angular` and `@angular-devkit/build-webpack`) are now deprecated. Migrate to the `@angular/build` builders (esbuild/application) for your application builds.

items.title: 22.0.0-ssr-commonengine-deprecated
items.action: `CommonEngine` APIs from `@angular/ssr` are deprecated. Migrate to `AngularNodeAppEngine` or `AngularAppEngine` instead.

items.title: 22.0.0-istanbul-lib-instrument-optional
items.action: `istanbul-lib-instrument` is now an optional peer dependency. If your project uses Karma with code coverage enabled, ensure `istanbul-lib-instrument` is explicitly installed.

items.title: 22.0.0-dev-server-port-env-priority
items.action: `ng serve` now gives the highest priority to the `PORT` environment variable. This value overrides any port configured in `angular.json` or provided via the `--port` flag.

items.title: 22.0.0-architect-cli-removed
items.action: The `@angular-devkit/architect-cli` package is no longer available. Use the `architect` CLI tool from the `@angular-devkit/architect` package instead.

items.title: 22.0.0-experimental-test-builders-removed
items.action: The experimental `@angular-devkit/build-angular:jest` and `@angular-devkit/build-angular:web-test-runner` test builders have been removed.
